messages:
Aisha Saleh: Quick spike idea: introduce a per-route "redact_budget" (tokens/month) and a sticky sampler keyed by client_id for predictable audit samples. We can expose a console meter and an inspect flow.
Ben Hart: Sounds good. How do clients express intent to capture raw? header like X-RW-Redact: none|partial|full?
Aisha Saleh: Yup. SDKs set X-RW-Redact. Server enforces maximum allowed by tenant + route policy. client header is advisory.
Ravi Menon: Security: must HMAC sample ids and only allow unmask via the console using signed inspector tokens. No raw returns without RBAC + justification.
Tess O'Connor: On telemetry: always emit aggregated metrics (latency, token histograms) for every request regardless of redact to keep SLOs intact. Individual payloads only when sampled.
Marta Silva: Console UX: route page shows budget remaining %, sparkline, recent sampled rows (metadata only), and "Request unmask" button on each sample. Clicking opens modal with TTL + justification.
Ben Hart: Implementation sketch: request -> evaluate route policy -> budget_left = route_quota - used; sampling_prob = clamp(budget_left / expected_traffic, 0, 1); sample = sticky_hash(client_id) < sampling_prob -> if sampled, create sample record {route, redact_hint, effective_policy, sample_id, sample_sig}.
Ravi Menon: We should rotate tenant HMAC keys periodically. Also use short-lived inspector tokens that reference sample_id and are single-use. Log every unmask request to audit log.
Aisha Saleh: Ops rule: if budget_left < 5% auto-fail to full redaction for non-owner tokens and flag route on the SRE dashboard. Provide a manual kill-switch on route page.
Tess O'Connor: Metrics: sampling.budget_remaining, sampling.sticky_hit_rate, sampling.unmask.requested, sampling.unmask.approved, sampling.tokens_saved. Also expose per-route estimated cost savings.
Ben Hart: Pseudo sample payload: ```json
{
  "route": "/v1/complete",
  "redact_hint": "partial",
  "effective_policy": "quota-capped",
  "sample_id": "s_20241101_01",
  "sample_sig": "hmac:...",
  "sampled": true
}
```
Marta Silva: UX question: do we auto-approve owners? Proposal: auto-approve for route owners within tenant, otherwise require oncall approval. All approvals create audit entries.
Ravi Menon: I'll draft HMAC scheme + inspector token flow. Recommend storing only redacted blobs and fetching raw on-demand to avoid storing PII.
Aisha Saleh: I'll write an RFC with policy schema examples, console mockups, and SDK change notes. Who can take the server proto?
Ben Hart: I'll do server proto (sampler + budget math). Tess can own dashboards.
deploy-bot: CI started for branch feat/redact-budget-sticky-sampler (build 621). Tests queued. :rocket:
